host_boundary: T15 owns typed write_note, edit_note, move_note, and delete_note on the existing ipc_invoke union. These are host commands, not raw callTool. Every command requires ExplicitRouteArgs (workspace + project). write_note adds identifier + title + body. edit_note adds identifier + body. move_note adds identifier + destination (permalink, not a filesystem path). delete_note adds identifier. deny_unknown_fields. Extra path/root is schema. Non-fixture route or filesystem identifier/destination is policy and does not open the library. RouteState.project is not an implicit write target. Production default is EmptyLibrary: all four CRUD ops are unsupported with engine/library unavailable. Tests inject FixtureLibrary over generated owned temp roots {temp}/bmdock-t15-*. T15 does not start/stop Supervisor, spawn engines, open user vaults, mix release/main-preview tool counts, call rmcp/live MCP, or write %APPDATA% Obsidian / user vault / global Basic Memory config. save_draft/load_draft remain distinct from write_note. engine_persisted stays false. P0 bmdock-probe and just contract/contract-main stay independent. just build stays the G0 probe. just dev remains the T08 Tauri shell.

AC08.claim: Fixture tests write BMDock-owned markdown whose body includes Chinese text and wiki-link [[欢迎]], then observe the physical file {temp}/bmdock-t15-*/welcome.md. classified_as=disk_verified, disk_verified=true, files_written=true, envelope_is_not_disk_proof=true, engine_persisted=false. Envelope-only saved text is accepted_unverified and files_written=false. The command does not write into %APPDATA%, user Obsidian, or global Basic Memory config, and does not call MCP write_note.

AC10.claim: After write_note and edit_note, tests compare the returned body to the physical markdown file, including Chinese text and [[欢迎]]. Envelope saved is not disk proof. Draft save_draft remains a distinct T14 path.

AC11.claim: edit_note overwrite/replaces the body of an existing identifier. Tests observe the new physical file body and that it differs from the original. Missing identifier is unsupported.

AC12.claim: move_note renames an identifier within the owned fixture library. The old path is gone and the new path exists with the same body. Destination is a permalink. Filesystem destination is policy and does not open the library. Sequential move onto an existing destination is unsupported and does not claim T16 concurrent overwrite.

AC13.claim: delete_note removes the physical owned file. Missing after delete is success-with-observation (disk_verified when absence is observed), not user-vault success. Envelope-only delete is accepted_unverified.

AC14.claim: Every CRUD call carries ExplicitRouteArgs. Extra path/root is schema. Non-fixture project or workspace is policy and does not open the library even if RouteState.project is already bmdock-fixture. implicit_current_project_writes stays false.
